diagnostics.message: trigger phrasing "conformance base gatilho um" is already claimed by capability:conformance.projection.collision-first (normal form "conformance base gatilho um"). Two capabilities may not share a phrasing: the projection's entire purpose is to SEPARATE capabilities in retrieval space, and a shared phrasing teaches the retriever they are the same point. Fix it by adding the disambiguating token the customer actually says — "do carrinho" vs "do pedido que já fiz" — not by deleting one side.
